2.3.37 Report.Width
Applies to RDL 2003/10, RDL 2005/01, and RDL 2008/01
The Report.Width element specifies the width of a Report. This element MUST be specified, and its
value MUST be an RdlSize.
Following is the parent element of the Report.Width element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="1" />
